seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How Alliance Street Consultancy collects, uses and protects information submitted through this website.

sections.heading: Privacy Policy
sections.subhead: How we handle information submitted through this website.

sections.notice: This is placeholder legal copy pending review by qualified counsel — do not treat it as final until reviewed.

items.heading: Introduction
items.body: {{company.name}} ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

items.heading: Information We Collect
items.body: When you press Continue on our consultation or appointment form, we save your name, country, address, email, contact number, selected services and any notes you provide. We also record the submission time and whether you request an enquiry follow-up or choose appointment booking. These details are saved even if you do not finish the booking. A temporary authentication identifier is kept for the browser session to protect and update your submission.

items.heading: How We Use Information
items.body: We use the details you submit to respond to your service enquiry, follow up on your request and coordinate appointments. We do not sell or rent your information to third parties.

items.heading: Data Sharing
items.body: We use Google Firebase to store consultation and appointment enquiries. The enquiry database is hosted in London, United Kingdom. Access is restricted through authentication and database rules. If you choose to book an appointment, you open Zoom’s scheduling service and provide booking information there under Zoom’s own privacy terms. Form details are not automatically transferred to Zoom.

items.heading: Data Retention
items.body: We retain enquiry and client information for as long as necessary to provide our services and to meet our own legal and regulatory record-keeping obligations.

items.heading: Your Rights
items.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us at {{company.email}}.

items.heading: Contact
items.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to {{company.email}} or {{company.address}}.
